label: STRUCTURAL FRAME MODULE
story: A twin-downtube spine cut from a scrapped motorcycle frame and re-welded around a rickshaw axle bracket. Load paths follow the recycled tubing, not the drawing.

label: ENERGY MODULE (FICTIONAL)
story: A sealed lead-acid bank rewired into a balanced buffer pack and topped with a resonant coupling coil lifted from a dead monitor flyback. The glowing core on the stand is a display model, not a live cell.
spec: two dead IPS units, one flyback

label: ARMOUR SHELL MODULE
story: Hand-formed plates beaten from a corrugated tin roof sheet, an old petrol can and two motorcycle fairings, then shimmed with bicycle inner-tube rubber at every contact.
